texts.preamble: M/S Garima Milk And Food Prodcuct And A vs State Of Rajasthan Through Pp on 19 September, 2016 Author: Mohammad Rafiq Bench: Mohammad Rafiq 1 S.B. Criminal Misc. Petition No. 5492/2015 In The High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan Bench At Jaipur. Order
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners argued that the complaint in the present case was filed after more than one year and, therefore, it was barred by limitation. Learned Public Prosecutor opposed the petition and submitted that the trial court has merely invited attention of the Food Safety Officer towards proviso to Section 77 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006(for short 'the Act of 2006') which empowers the Commissioner of Food Safety to extend period of limitation up to three years.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners argued that the complaint in the present case was filed after more than one year and, therefore, it was barred by limitation.
